Chapter 6815: Natural Primordial Item

Chapter 6815: Natural Primordial Item

Everyone knew that becoming an immortal was difficult even in Heavenrealm. Countless geniuses had appeared in Heavenrealm. Compared to them, those from the minor worlds were insignificant.

The most brilliant in the minor worlds could only find themselves embarrassed once meeting a genius in Heavenrealm.

Surpassing two major realms was still impossible for these geniuses - a wild fantasy. How could one jump from an ancient ancestor to an immortal? This process would take eras.

“It’s a legend.” Ironleaf said: “But this supreme progenitor was beaten down and had to run.”

“Hmm, Mang’s direct disciples. That Guangmai?” Thunder Emperor asked.

“Yes, the guardian of the gate.” Six-foot said.

“Our progenitor had a different view on this.” Ironleaf said.

“Go on.” Six-foot said.

“That Guangmai wasn’t the guardian, he was looking for it too and might have figured out some clues.” Ironleaf elaborated: “If anyone had known of its existence, it would be Golden Immortal.”

“Then what was this gate?” Thunder Emperor asked.

“There should be a heart of our world, a natural primordial item. Guangmai wanted to become a primordial immortal and needed it, hoping to surpass Mang.” Ironleaf said.

“A heart?” Listeners couldn’t imagine it.

For golden immortals to reach the next step, they needed a legacy. The best legacies were primordial items, especially the ones formed naturally.

However, rumor has it Heavenrealm didn’t have any.

“It should be real.” Ironleaf said.

“What happened next?” Thunder asked.

“Guangmai had spent so much effort on finding it, so I’m sure the gate existed.” Six-foot said.

“Yes, my progenitor had not heard of Guangmai getting it, so maybe the gate was never found. Perhaps they only made it there and couldn’t get in. He then disappeared later.” Ironleaf said: “But there is one thing that can prove the gate’s existence.”

“What is it?” Blaze asked right away.

“Deepsouth Emperor. He betrayed Guardian Alliance, for what? Perhaps it was related to a deal with Devouring Alliance.” Ironleaf said.

All eyes were on Tinyleaf City Lord afterward.

“Both supposedly died in battle.” The ancient ancestors realized something.

If Deepsouth Emperor died and Immortal Emperor Fei survived long enough to pass away in Tinyleaf, then wouldn’t he also have had the key item? The shrine immediately popped up in their mind.

“I, I have no idea.” The city lord became nervous.

“Take it out so that we can take a look.” Ironleaf said.

The city lord glanced at Li Qiye. If this were related to the so-called Gate of Wisdom, it would never be returned. He wouldn’t be able to answer to his ancestors after death.

However, they needed protection right now. How could they refuse the words of their protectors? This became quite an unsolvable predicament for him.

His glance told the others that Li Qiye had the shrine.

“Take out your shrine.” Ironleaf told Li Qiye.

“No need, you won’t figure out anything after seeing it.” Li Qiye smiled and shook his head.

“Ridiculous!” An iron tree shouted.

Many glared at him, wanting to slap his face to teach him a lesson. As for the city lord, he had a pained expression while tugging Li Qiye’s sleeve. All he wanted was for Li Qiye to be more polite.

Ironleaf Ancestor raised his hand and stopped his men. He stared at Li Qiye and said: “Have to try to know.”

“If it were so simple, the Gate of Wisdom would have been taken long ago.” Li Qiye smiled.

The group heard this and agreed with his logic. If ancient ancestors such as themselves could figure it out, then Guangmai would have found it long ago.

“Interesting, I like your style, brat.” Six-foot came over and patted Li Qiye’s shoulder: “Quite a personality on a human.”
